agent.problem: The second sentence says that Paul likewise does not give deacons the job until they have proven themselves. That already retells the testing-before-service movement of verse 10, so citing only verse 9 is narrower than what the card uses.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.

agent.problem: Verse 16's movements “was proclaimed among the nations” and “was believed in throughout the world” are never told or positively asked. Learning only that the news was not a secret shared by a few does not give the baker those two important parts of the confession.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.

agent.problem: “Him” and “the list” have no antecedent within the question and depend on remembering earlier cards. The question should identify whose confession or list it is, such as the One who appeared in the flesh, so it stands alone.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
